read.thesis: Middle East war steepens global petchem cost curve; LYB guides sharp Q2 sequential improvement, raises European O&P rates to 80% and maximises North American rates, with Q1 EBITDA ex-items $615M versus $417M in Q4.

utilisation.quote: raising rates for European O&P assets to 80%

triggers.label: Polyethylene prices accelerating on war supply gap
triggers.quote: Tightening market conditions associated with the war in the Middle East supported higher polyethylene prices in both domestic and export markets.

triggers.label: Operating-rate cuts could accelerate capacity rationalisation
triggers.quote: Reductions in operating rates and shutdowns associated with the war could accelerate capacity rationalizations to support a more constructive supply and demand balance

triggers.label: Four European sites sold
triggers.quote: LYB reached an important milestone in its portfolio transformation with the completion of the sale of four European assets.

triggers.label: European O&P rates raised to 80%
triggers.quote: raising rates for European O&P assets to 80%

triggers.label: Operating cash use $269M on working capital build
triggers.quote: LyondellBasell used $269 million in cash from operating activities during the first quarter.

guidance.value: significant sequential improvement across almost all businesses
guidance.quote: market conditions are expected to support significant sequential improvement across almost all businesses
raising rates for European O&P assets to 80%
